description: CREATE TABLE base semantics (issue #85 T06-A1/A2/A3/A4/A5/A7/A8/A9/A10/A11/A12/A13/A14): the accepted 56-case primary-key/nullability/default-presence subset plus 16 DEFAULT NULL cases, 12 provider default-identity cases, 40 declared CHAR/VARCHAR length cases, 64 charset/collation cases, 40 comment-fidelity cases, 28 explicit audit-time-column role cases, 36 AUTO_INCREMENT declaration cases, and 32 single-member primary-key BIGINT/UNSIGNED cases, and 36 ordinary-column NOT NULL cases, and 52 type-family forbid cases — the A13 subset isolates ddl.column.blob_text.forbid, ddl.column.json.forbid, ddl.column.bit.forbid, ddl.column.float_double.forbid, and ddl.column.timestamp.forbid under per-rule on/false blocker profiles with the all-rules-disabled control, pinning per-column finding attribution (blob/text excluding JSON, timestamp excluding DATETIME, the independent float/double metadata shape) plus the ordered nine-column DATA_TYPE oracle on all four anchors regardless of the policy verdict — the A11 offline matrix isolates ddl.table.primary_key.bigint.require and ddl.table.primary_key.unsigned.require (required=true) under single-rule blocker profiles across both dialects (composite primary keys skip the member check; the off controls reuse the all-rules-disabled profile), while the anchored roles pin DATA_TYPE, a finite-whitelist COLUMN_TYPE complete form, byte-empty EXTRA, and ordered single-member PK binding regardless of the policy verdict. The A12 subset adds three single-rule isolations of ddl.column.not_null.require (strict/time-allow/not-required) — the offline matrix pins per-column finding attribution and the loaded/applicable/absent rule_summary contract, while the anchored roles pin the ordered column set (name/DATA_TYPE/ordinal/IS_NULLABLE) with zero PK constraints regardless of the policy verdict. The A14 subset adds 60 table-option allowlist cases: 36 offline roles across three families (ddl.table.engine.allowlist values=[InnoDB], ddl.table.charset.allowlist values=[utf8mb4], ddl.table.row_format.allowlist values=[DYNAMIC]) under per-family strict/optional isolated blocker profiles plus the all-rules-disabled control — pinning the complete require_explicit contract (explicit disallowed values reject under both switches, omission rejects only under strict, omitted-optional stays loaded=1/applicable=1) — and 24 anchored roles whose driver-applied CREATEs record per-product catalog facts: MySQL engine/row_format storage values, TiDB's InnoDB/Compact compatibility display, and the declared charset through the real TABLE_COLLATION association. The A15 subset adds 24 offline row-size fact-resolution cases: ddl.table.row_size.max_bytes.require under on/not-required isolated profiles plus the all-off control, pinning the strict 65535 boundary, column-over-table charset precedence with the table-level metadata contract, the declared non-InnoDB scope skip, field-ordered missing_instance_fact gaps, and the determined-finding-plus-gap coexistence role.
